title: Search Insert Position
problemStatement: Master “Search Insert Position” (BS on 1D Arrays) the way an interviewer expects: classify, brute, optimize, prove.
intuition: "Search Insert Position": monotonic predicate; invariant answer in [lo,hi).

approaches.title: Linear scan
Binary search
approaches.code:
def solve(a,x):
    lo,hi=0,len(a)
    while lo<hi:
        mid=(lo+hi)//2
        if a[mid]<x: lo=mid+1
        else: hi=mid
    return lo
